issue.title: SQL: Handle null literal for AND and OR in `WHERE`

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Eliminate `null` literal in the `Optimizer` where we know that we
are in the WHERE clause so we can evaluate NULL to false. Now the
`null` literal is not reaching the `QueryTranslator`.

Fixes: #35088

body:
Likely the nullability of the right side is reported incorrectly. `IS NULL` is not nullable which should cause `OR` to not be nullable.
As a separate side, due to the 3VL, both `OR` and `AND` need to take into account their folding - if it's possible, then they are not nullable (one side is `true` for `OR` or one is `false` for `AND`).

Yep, also functions like POSITION can have any of their arguments NULL so they are nullable->true if at least one of their children is nullable, I think the logic currently is inversed: nullable->false if any of the children is not nullable
